# MTG (Musa The Giant) | musathegiant.com

> musathegiant.com is the personal site of Musa The Giant (MTG), a crypto educator and affiliate marketer based in Durban, South Africa. His mission is to help everyday people build generational wealth. The site shares the Bitcoin, crypto, AI and trading income streams he is currently using, and tools such as a live crypto halving countdown.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.musathegiant.com/): Introduction to MTG and the "Multiple Streams of Income" idea, linking to the income streams dashboard.
- [Free Crypto 101 Crash Course](https://www.musathegiant.com/101/): Free online crypto course for beginners by MTG, in plain English. 21 short lessons (money, Bitcoin, blockchain, Web3, exchanges, wallets, scams, account security, wallet drainers, DYOR research, tokenomics, token unlocks, whitepapers, on-chain research, AI and crypto, sectors, portfolio building, market cycles, crypto debit cards, crypto rules and tax, first steps), 63 quiz questions, a 222-term glossary, 5 step-by-step setup guides (VALR, Binance, MetaMask, SafePal, buying BNB) and a certificate of completion. Register free with a first name and email; progress is saved in the browser. Graduates post their certificate in the Crypto 101 Crash Course WhatsApp group.
- [Tools](https://www.musathegiant.com/tools/): Directory of tools by MTG, both free and premium, currently the crypto halving countdown, the dollar to rand and Bitcoin converter, the Bitcoin DCA calculator, and the GitHub Pages custom domain guide. New tools are added here.
- [Crypto Halving Countdown](https://www.musathegiant.com/halving/): Live countdowns to the next reward halvings for Bitcoin (BTC), Litecoin (LTC), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Bitcoin SV (BSV), Zcash (ZEC), Bittensor (TAO), Ravencoin (RVN) and Kaspa (KAS). Uses live block heights from public blockchain explorers. Includes Bitcoin halving history and an FAQ.
- [Dollar to Rand & Bitcoin Converter](https://www.musathegiant.com/converter/): Free live currency converter. Converts US dollars (USD) to South African rand (ZAR) and back, and Bitcoin (BTC) or satoshis to rand, dollars and 20+ other currencies at the live market rate (Coinbase, refreshed every 30 seconds). Shareable links such as /converter/?amount=50&from=USD&to=ZAR.
- [MTG Bitcoin DCA Calculator](https://www.musathegiant.com/dca/): Free dollar-cost averaging calculator. Enter an amount, weekly or monthly buys, a start and end date, and an optional fee, in ZAR or USD. Shows total invested, Bitcoin accumulated, average purchase price, current value, profit or loss, percentage return, a lump-sum comparison and a chart. Uses historical daily prices (Coinbase Exchange, plus ECB USD/ZAR rates). Educational only, not financial advice.
- [About MTG](https://www.musathegiant.com/about.html): Who Musa The Giant is, his story, mission and what he checks before sharing any opportunity.
- [Contact](https://www.musathegiant.com/contact.html): WhatsApp +27 72 171 4626 and social links. MTG never asks for passwords or seed phrases.
- [GitHub Pages Custom Domain Guide](https://www.musathegiant.com/github-pages-custom-domain-guide.html): Step-by-step guide to hosting a free website on GitHub Pages with a custom domain, including exact DNS records and HTTPS.
- [Income Streams Dashboard](https://www.musathegiant.com/dashboard.html): The income streams MTG currently shares. Income Stream #1 is Bitcoin Wealth (entry point 0.001 BTC). Income Stream #2 is ClickBaitPays (advertise, view ads and earn, from $14).

## Quick facts: upcoming halvings (estimates)

- Bitcoin: block 1,050,000, around April 2028, reward 3.125 to 1.5625 BTC.
- Litecoin: block 3,360,000, around July 2027, reward 6.25 to 3.125 LTC.
- Bitcoin Cash and Bitcoin SV: block 1,050,000, around April 2028.
- Zcash: around November 2028 (the NU7 upgrade changes block times but keeps the halving date).
- Bittensor: at 15.75 million TAO issued, around December 2029 at the earliest.
- Ravencoin: block 6,300,000, around January 2030.
- Kaspa: reward shrinks about 5.6% every month (halves yearly).
Live, up-to-date dates: https://www.musathegiant.com/halving/
